mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.wo_no, w.wo_type, w.status, w.qty, w.finished_qty, w.plan_start, w.plan_end, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, p.sales_order_no, c.name AS customer_name, COALESCE(p.due_date, o.delivery_date) AS due_date, (SELECT MAX(r.create_time) FROM mes_report r WHERE r.wo_id = w.id) AS last_report_time FROM mes_work_order w JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = w.material_id LEFT JOIN mes_plan p ON p.id = w.plan_id LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = p.sales_order_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = o.partner_id WHERE w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') ORDER BY w.id

SELECT o.*, c.name AS work_center_name FROM mes_wo_op o JOIN mes_work_order w ON w.id = o.wo_id LEFT JOIN mes_work_center c ON c.id = o.work_center_id WHERE w.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') ORDER BY o.wo_id, o.seq, o.id
SELECT r.op_id AS id, SUM(r.good_qty) AS good, SUM(r.scrap_qty) AS scrap, SUM(r.hours) AS hours, MAX(r.create_time) AS last_time FROM mes_report r WHERE r.report_date = #{day} GROUP BY r.op_id

SELECT o.work_center_id AS id, SUM(r.good_qty) AS good, SUM(r.scrap_qty) AS scrap, SUM(r.hours) AS hours, MAX(r.create_time) AS last_time FROM mes_report r JOIN mes_wo_op o ON o.id = r.op_id WHERE r.report_date = #{day} GROUP BY o.work_center_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order w WHERE w.finish_time >= #{from} AND w.finish_time < #{to} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_wo_op o WHERE o.wo_id = w.id AND o.work_center_id = #{wc})
